beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book's tension therefore runs in both directions between reflection and committed action.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader must ask who carries the cost when either mode declares itself sufficient.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Room with All the Futures in It.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its accumulated unfinished projects give the philosophical argument a concrete setting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits readers who organize ambitious work or repeatedly postpone a difficult decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its particular challenge is asking what an insight changes for someone who must act.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The counterargument then tests action against the conditions it consumes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading keeps both scales in view without granting either thinker a permanent exemption.
